mapper.select: select f.id, f.product_id, f.create_time, p.name as productName, p.main_image, p.status as productStatus, mp.shop_name as merchantName, sku_agg.min_price as minPrice, sku_agg.total_stock as totalStock from user_favorite f left join product p on f.product_id = p.id left join merchant_profile mp on p.merchant_id = mp.user_id left join ( select product_id, MIN(price) as min_price, SUM(stock) as total_stock from product_sku where deleted = 0 group by product_id ) sku_agg on p.id = sku_agg.product_id where f.user_id = #{userId} and p.deleted = 0 order by f.create_time desc
